resolution: Diagnosed the 'LCField is not defined' crash in ImportModelDialog: NOT a real code bug — LCField is a hoisted top-level helper used by ImportTextureDialog and a dozen other dialogs before its definition, and current source bundles clean (tsc-check passes). It was a stale/mid-race dev bundle from when two sessions were hot-reloading Studio.tsx concurrently. Fix = a clean re-bundle (reload the dev host). While in there, fixed a real UX bug I'd left: ImportModelDialog's default path was hardcoded to model.glb which never matches genmodel's <slug>.glb output — it now self-computes the default by listing cart/hmsc-int/data/generated for the newest .glb (added listDir import). The edit also forces the fresh re-bundle that clears the crash. tsc-check passes. Committed; user should reload/re-ship the dev host then retry Import GLB.
